meta.tx_encoding: ASCII: <HEX> atau <HEX>;<param> diakhiri CRLF; HEX = cmd.ToString("X") (huruf besar, tanpa padding nol)

dispatch_first_token.behavior: FEEDBACK_READ_USER_DEF_2 (balasan 1617): persiapan masuk live, set var_awal/lanjut/pilihan, isLiveState=0
FRAME TELEMETRI/STATUS: cabang assigndataStatus (parse "depan") atau masuk_live (parse gauge live)
ACK: mesin state lanjutan (kirim baris map remote 8601/8602/8603/8605, langkah save, 360C, refresh 4605, dst.)
FEEDBACK_READ_TPS_CAL: parse tegangan kalibrasi TPS (tampil "x.xx V")

literal_frames.evidence: Form1.lanjut_echo IL_0033, ulang_echo_Tick IL_0001, SerialHandler_NewConnection IL_0060

literal_frames.purpose: READ_ENGINE_STOP dipakai sebagai request STATUS (SendStatus; balasan frame A603)
SAVE_FUEL_COR1 satu baris (61 nilai RPM) - loop telemetri/auto-tune

bulk.flow: RX bulk: akumulasi byte -> cari begin marker -> ambil tepat SizeOf(struktur) byte -> Parse struct -> (log: hitung CRC_LOG) -> akhiri saat end marker; ukuran dicek dengan GetCalSize/GetMapSize/GetLogSize

crc.byte_order: input dibaca sebagai kata uint32 little-endian (Buffer.BlockCopy)
usage: CRC_CAL = f(bytes cal_t) dibandingkan dengan bagian cal dari balasan 9500
CRC_MAP = f(bytes coreJ6_t) dibandingkan dengan bagian map dari balasan 9500
CRC_LOG = f(bytes antara #B3# dan *eE*) disimpan saat bulk log
crc.evidence: JukenDataManagement.ComputeSTM32Checksum(UInt32[]) IL_0000-IL_0041; ComputeSTM32Checksum(Byte[]) IL_0000-IL_008D; isGetMapValid IL_0000-IL_008D (ldc.i4 79764919, ldc.i4.m1)

structs.note: Semua struct StructLayout sequential + MarshalAs (U1/I2/U2/ByValArray), serialisasi Marshal.StructureToPtr/PtrToStructure -> little-endian, tanpa packing khusus (pack default)

struct_semantics.coreJ6_t: peta (map): FuelBase int16[1281], InjTmg uint16[1281], IgnTmg uint16[1281], FuelCor1 int8[1281], FuelCorTB1 int8[1281]; 1281 = 21 baris TPS x 61 kolom RPM; indeks = tpsIdx*61 + rpmIdx (inferensi kuat: UI memakai posisi_tps 0..20 dan posisi_rpm 0..60)
struct_semantics.cal_t: parameter kalibrasi: tabel16/61 titik + blok ecu_pt(256) + identitas EcuName[21]/EcuType[21]/SoftVer[21] + appl_t + Bike_ft + engine_pt; CRC_CAL dihitung atas seluruh struct
struct_semantics.log_t: satu sampel data logger (28 byte): indeks titik TPS/RPM +13 pengukuran uint16
struct_semantics.identity: EcuName/EcuType/SoftVer berada di cal_t offset835/856/877 (21 byte each) - didapat via bulk #B1#

timing.name: timer_live_enter

timing.action: Delay(100) awal; poll balasan tiap10 ms (budget ~100 poll ~=1 dtk); retry <=10x; antar kirim Delay(100 ms start, timerDelayBetweenSend 1 ms)
